comments.author: tstrimple
comments.story_title: What I Learned from Two Years of Teaching High School CS
comments.why_zh: 让死记硬背的微积分公式终于变得清晰。
comments.quote_zh: 当我发现那个视频时，他们试图让我死记硬背的所有公式都变得明白多了。
comments.text_zh: 我高中时把所有能选的高等数学课都上了。尽管我讨厌学校，是个糟糕的学生。但我把数学当作谜题来解，挺享受的。直到我接触到微积分。那位老师对这门学科掌握得并不扎实，更重要的是，那只是死记微积分公式，而不是理解任何实际应用。相比之下，我的 AdMatics（高等数学与物理）课让我们做基于真实世界的物理实验。这些工具的应用一目了然。如果我当时有一节像这样拆解问题空间的微积分课（[VIDEO]），我大概就不会在那时终止我的正式数学教育了。当我发现那个视频时，他们试图让我死记硬背的所有公式都变得明白多了。
comments.text: I took all the advanced math classes available to me in high school. This was despite me hating school and being a terrible student. But I enjoyed math as puzzles to solve. This was until I got into calculus. The teacher didn't have a strong grasp of the subject and more importantly it was just memorizing calculus formulas instead of understanding any sort of real-world application. In contrast, my AdMatics (advanced math and physics) class had us doing real-world physics based experiments. The application of the tools was immediately obvious. If I had a calculus lesson that broke down the problem space like this ( [VIDEO] ) I probably wouldn't have stopped my formal education in math at that point. When I discovered that video, all the formulas they tried to make me memorize started making a LOT more sense.

comments.author: hiaux0
comments.story_title: Ask HN: How to self-learn math?
comments.why_zh: 用于培养抽象思维的数学基础系列。
comments.text_zh:
+1 而且一定要认真跟着他的“暂停并思考”环节。如果你想提升数学能力，学会用数学的方式思考至关重要。就像成为优秀的程序员需要自己写大量代码，或者成为优秀的舞者需要练习舞步一样。对数学来说，这就是抽象思维。欣赏数学是一回事，有自律去自学则完全是另一回事。

编辑：关于你的第二个编辑：他的视频是为尽可能广泛的受众制作的。我建议你挑任何当下最让你感兴趣的主题的视频。你会发现自己缺少哪些知识（把这些记下来！），并可以从那里扩展。无论是去看他的数学基础 ((1)) 系列 [0],[1]，还是只是重看一遍。

((1))：和其他任何事情一样，了解你的基础对理解一个主题很重要。如果你完全不懂线性代数，即使你能应用（复制粘贴）一些机器学习技术，也对你毫无帮助。

[0]: [LINK]
[1]: [VIDEO]
comments.text: +1 And definitely follow through his "pause and ponder" sections. If you want to build up your maths skills, it is crucial to learn how to think in the maths way. Like becoming a good programmer involves writing lots of code yourself, or to become a good dancer you need to practice your steps. For maths it's abstract thinking. Appreciation of maths is one thing, having the discipline to self-study a whole other. Edit. Regarding your 2nd Edit: His videos are made for the broadest audience possible. I'd recommend picking any video whose topic interests you the most at the moment. You will see what knowledge you lack (take notes of these!) and can expand from there. Be it to watch his maths fundamental ((1)) series [0],[1] or just rewatch. ((1)): As in any other things, knowing your fundamentals is significant to the understanding of a topic. It won't help you at all if you can apply (copy paste) some machine learning techniques if you don't know about linear algebra at all. [0]: [LINK] [1]: [VIDEO]

comments.author: jlos
comments.why_zh: 建立对微积分概念的直觉理解。
comments.text_zh: 回答你的主要问题——“需要什么水平的数学”，其实更关键的是涵盖哪些主题：学几门微积分、线性代数和离散数学的入门课，就能让那句话变得可理解了。我会给出一些定义和资源，但想想你会怎么向一个孩子解释乘法/除法/代数。到了某个阶段，你就是得动手做一些问题，数学自然就通了。所以我会解释上面那些术语，但最好的办法还是去上几门我提到的主题的课。快速定义：- 指数：是常数 e 的某个数次方。e 和 pi 一样，是数学和自然界中无处不在的常数。做几何时会遇到 pi，做微积分时会遇到 e。- 数学中的函数类似于编程中的函数，但不完全一样。离散数学课程在这里会有帮助。- f 撇是微积分中用来表示一种函数（称为导数）与另一种函数之间关系的记号。f 和 f' 是相关的。但究竟如何相关，最好通过学微积分来解释。- 本征函数存在于方程组中。可以把它想成一个“平衡”点。线性代数会有助于理解这个术语。资源 - Essence of Calculus：[VIDEO] - Essence of Linear Algebra：[LINK] 这两个视频能很好地给你微积分和线性代数背后的“直觉”。不过，和编程一样，你得真正动手做一些题，东西才能吸收进去。Fo
comments.text: To answer your main question - "what level of maths" do you need is more about what topics: a couple introductory classes in Calculus, Linear Algebra, and Discrete Mathematics will make that sentence understandable. I'll give some definitions and resources, but think about how you would explain multiplication/division/algebra to a kid. At some point, you just have to work through some problems and the math just makes sense. So I'll explain the terms above, but best bet is to just take a few courses on the topics I mentioned above. Quick definitions: - Exponential: is the constant e to the power of some number. e, like pi, is a ubitiqous constant in mathematics and nature. You run into pi when doing geometry, and e when doing calculus. - A function in mathematics is similar to a function in programming, but not exactly. A course in Discrete Mathematics helps here. - F-apostrophe is notation used in calculus to show the relation of one type of function, called a derivative to another. f and f' are related. How, though, is better explained by taking calculus. - An eigenfunction exists in a system of equations. Think of it like a 'balance' point. Linear Algebra will help make sense of this term. Resources - Essence of Calculus: [VIDEO] - Essence of Linear Algebra: [LINK] Those 2 video's will do a good job of giving you the 'intuition' behind Calculus and Linear Algebra. Like programming, though, you just have to actually work some problems out by hand for the stuff to sink in. Fo
